livingCosts.notes: Oxford 'Likely living costs 2027-28' (latest published; single full-time student, no dependants), range midpoints per month: food £325-£560, accommodation incl. bills £880-£1,025, personal items £165-£320, social activities £50-£135, study costs £35-£95, other £20-£40; total £1,475-£2,175/month, £13,275-£19,575 for 9 months. Personal = personal items + social + study + other. Transport not itemised, so 0. www.ox.ac.uk blocks automated access; figures read from the Wayback Machine copy of this page dated 2026-09-07.
